ui.title: Cult of the Lamb Planner
ui.tagline: Plan your base on the real in-game grid
ui.metaDescription: Plan your Cult of the Lamb base on the real in-game grid and share it as a link.
ui.landTitle: Land upgrades you've bought (the game sells them in this order)
ui.emptyText: Pick a building on the left, then click the ground. Drag to place a row, scroll to zoom.
ui.emptyTextTouch: Pick a building below, then drag it onto the ground. Pinch to zoom.
ui.capToiletsHint: Followers use a toilet after every meal. An Outhouse fills after 5 uses, an Outhouse II after 15, until it's emptied.
ui.materialsHint: What the layout costs to build, upgrades included. The Temple you start with is free.
ui.levelsHint: {n} levels: pick one on the map
ui.cantDelete: The game won't delete this, only move it
ui.limitText1: The game allows one per base, counting every level. Move it here instead?
ui.limitTextN: The game allows {n} per base, counting every level. Move the oldest one here instead?
ui.lostLand: Removed buildings on land you haven't bought: {n}. Ctrl+Z brings them back.
ui.noFitLevel: It doesn't fit there at its current level.
ui.cantRemove: The game won't let you remove {name}, only move it.
ui.cleared: Map cleared. Press Ctrl+Z to undo.
ui.copied: Link copied. Anyone with it sees this layout.
ui.noClipboard: Couldn't reach the clipboard. Copy the address bar instead.
ui.importTitle: Import your base from a save
ui.importText: Pick slot_N.mp from the game's saves folder (slot_N.json on older versions). The file is read here in your browser and never uploaded. It replaces the current layout; Ctrl+Z brings it back.
ui.importedSkipped: Imported {n} buildings; skipped {m} the planner can't place.
ui.importFailed: Couldn't read that file as a Cult of the Lamb save.
ui.mapLabel: Base map. Pick a building, then click the ground to place it.
ui.helpClick: Place the picked building, or select a placed one to change its level
ui.helpDrag: Move a placed building, place a row of the picked one, or pan the map
ui.helpR: Flip the building you're holding or have selected
ui.helpM: Measure tool: drag across the ground to see how many cells a space is
ui.helpZoom: Zoom, fit the base to the screen
ui.sheetToggle: Show or hide the building list
ui.layoutsEmpty: No saved layouts yet. Save this one to come back to it later.
ui.layoutsNote: Kept in this browser only. The open layout saves every change; Share still makes a link.
ui.deleteLayoutText: “{name}” will be removed from this browser. Links to it still work.
ui.discardText: It isn't saved, so opening “{name}” loses it. Save it first or copy its link with Share.
ui.noStorage: This browser won't keep layouts (storage is off). Use Share to keep a link.
ui.perfText: Its animations are drawing at well under their frame rate. Lighter picture quality (textures and animations at ½ or ⅓) helps.
ui.perfAccel: This is usually caused by hardware acceleration being turned off in the browser's settings. How to turn it on:
ui.perfRestart: Restart the browser (not just the tab) after turning it on. If you're planning an unusually large base, you can ignore this.
ui.templatesIntro: Ready-made bases to start from or learn from. Loading one replaces the map; Ctrl+Z brings yours back.
ui.tplFarmText: Two fields of 32 plots, each with a farmer station in the middle. Scarecrows and harvest totems cover every plot, with silos and compost bins next to them.
ui.tplDecorText: A lantern-lined avenue from the Temple to a fountain plaza, with a pond garden beside it.
ui.tplWinterText: Shelters that never collapse, heaters and lightning rods covering every building, rotburn mines to keep the furnace fuelled and a bath to warm freezing followers.
ui.noTemplates: Couldn't load the templates. Check your connection and try again.

desc.FARM_PLOT: Grow a seed into a crop.
desc.BED: A place for a Follower to sleep. Very unstable, will often collapse.
desc.BED_2: Upgrade to a more stable shelter, which will collapse less often.
desc.BED_3: Give your Follower the luxury they deserve. Collects Devotion while they sleep. Never collapses.
desc.FARM_STATION: Farmer Station's allows Followers to water nearby crops.
desc.DECORATION_TREE: A pretty bush in a decorative pot.
desc.DANCING_FIREPIT: Your Followers will dance here beneath the moonlight to increase their Loyalty to you.
desc.BODY_PIT: Bury dead Followers in a simple pit. Avoids rotting corpses.
desc.KITCHEN: Allows Followers to cook meals for their fellow Cult members.
desc.COOKING_FIRE: Cook raw items and turn them into Meals that Followers can eat.
desc.CONFESSION_BOOTH: Hear a Follower's confession to increase their Loyalty. Can be used once a day.
desc.KNUCKLEBONES_ARENA: Play Knucklebones with your Followers. If you win they gain Loyalty, if you lose they gain nothing.
desc.FOOD_STORAGE: Store meals here to stop them from rotting.
desc.FOOD_STORAGE_2: Store more meals here to stop them from rotting.
desc.OUTHOUSE: Give your Followers somewhere to relieve themselves.
desc.COMPOST_BIN: Deposit grass to turn it into fertilizer.
desc.DECORATION_LAMB_STATUE: A statue of the mighty Lamb
